requirement_graphs.title: Integrated-Board DCDC1 Regulation and Load Stability

execution.observed_behavior: DCDC1 regulated low at 3.16V and collapsed below 2.5V during flash and WiFi load transients, hard-resetting the ESP32; a 3.4V setting improved operation but did not prevent the WiFi reboot surge from collapsing the rail, and one converter eventually failed completely.
The DCDC1 problem persisted after an attempted AXP2101 replacement, although the client noted that the replacement soldering may have been unsuccessful.
Factory testing found only one of three boards with stable L3 output; two fluctuated between 0.5V and 2V, with an AXP2101 thermal-pad assembly problem suspected as the yield issue.
X-ray inspection found the AXP2101 properly welded with no evidence of poor welding, but powering the two affected boards caused the positive terminal of the L3 capacitor to short to ground.

requirement_graphs.title: Integrated-Board USB Operation Without a Battery

execution.observed_behavior: With 5V USB input, load transients collapse the 3.3V rail below 2.5V and reset the ESP32, preventing standalone USB operation without a battery; battery-only operation succeeds.
None of the three integrated-board samples enumerated over native USB in normal or forced-download mode, in either USB-C orientation, while a known-good board enumerated with the same cable and port.
KiCad net tracing showed that USBLC6-2SC6 U3 pin 5 was connected to GND instead of the required +5V.
